name: Learning
note:
<Help: Experience tripled if level is below average compared to team; -5% to all stats>
<Custom Passive Condition>
if (user.isActor()) {
    var members = $gameParty.battleMembers();
    var total = 0;

    for (var i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
        total += members[i].level;
    }

    condition = members.length > 1 &&
                user.level < total / members.length;
} else {
    condition = false;
}
</Custom Passive Condition>
